description: Find the best Roth conversion amount for each year of a retirement plan, with living expenses funded from the right accounts and tax paid each year. Returns per-year conversions, taxes and balances, the after-tax wealth at the end with vs without conversions, totals, a plain-language plan narrative and the assumptions used. Advanced options (IRMAA, NIIT, real state brackets) are off by default. Runs in 1-3 seconds (up to ~15 with IRMAA/NIIT on a long horizon). All money in today's dollars. Optimal for the stated assumptions; not tax advice. Call get_conversion_example first if unsure of the shape.

advanced.description: Advanced layers, all OFF by default exactly like the web tool. IRMAA and NIIT make the solve a MILP (a few seconds longer; each solve is capped at 5 s, best plan found is returned).

irmaa.description: Model the Medicare Part B/D income surcharge (IRMAA) so conversions can avoid or accept tiers. Default false.

niit.description: Model the 3.8% Net Investment Income Tax. Default false.

code.description: Two-letter state code (e.g. 'KS'): uses that state's real 2026 brackets, standard deduction and credit.

exempts_social_security.description: The state does not tax Social Security. Default: true for IL and PA when 'code' is given, else false.

flat_rate_pct.description: Flat state rate, whole percent. Without 'code' it is the whole state model; with 'code' it only overrides the end-of-plan rate (default: the state's top rate).

retirement_exclusion.description: Yearly cap on IRA distributions the state excludes, dollars. Default 0.

age.description: Your age this year. The plan starts now (conversions can begin this year).

assumptions.description: Modeling assumptions; the defaults (same as the web tool) are reported back.

ltcg_pct.description: Flat capital-gains rate on gains realized during the plan. Default 15.

real_return_pct.description: Investment return above inflation, whole percent. Default 5.

retirement_tax_rate_pct.description: Income tax rate applied to leftover traditional money at the end of the plan (heirs' or your own). Default 24.

terminal_ltcg_pct.description: Capital-gains rate on leftover brokerage gain at the end. Default 15.

balances.description: Current household balances, dollars. Omitted = 0; at least one must be above 0.

brokerage_gain_long_term.description: Unrealized LONG-term gain inside the brokerage balance.

brokerage_gain_short_term.description: Unrealized SHORT-term gain inside the brokerage balance (long + short cannot exceed the balance).

recent_conversions.description: Roth conversions you made in the last 5 calendar years that are NOT yet penalty-free (this year and the 4 before). Each becomes penalty-free on Jan 1 five years after the year it was made; before 59.5 the plan only draws it penalty-free from then. Part of 'roth', not extra to it; with roth_penalty_free, cannot exceed 'roth'. Conversions only: contributions and older conversions go in roth_penalty_free. Default none.

year.description: Calendar year of the conversion (this year or one of the 4 before).

roth_penalty_free.description: Of the Roth balance, the part that can be withdrawn penalty-free before 59.5 (contributions and conversions at least 5 years old). Default 0; cannot exceed 'roth'. More recent conversions go in recent_conversions.

traditional.description: Traditional IRA / 401(k) (pre-tax) balance: the money that can be converted.

end_age.description: Plan until this age (default 90; horizon at most 70 years).

filing.description: Tax filing status. Default 'single'. 'married' = one joint return (both spouses assumed the same age).

find_max_spending.description: Instead of fixed spending, solve for the highest constant yearly spending the accounts can fund, ending near $0. Default false.

other_income.description: Other steady ordinary income (pension, rental, part-time pay), today's dollars. Omitted = none.

end_age.description: Last age it is received (default: end of plan).

start_age.description: First age it is received (default: now).

taxable_pct.description: Share of benefits taxed as ordinary income, whole percent. Default 85.

spending_end_age.description: Age spending ends (default: end of plan).

spending_per_year.description: Yearly spending the plan must fund, today's dollars, before income tax. Required unless find_max_spending is true.
